_what: WRITER x READER FACTORIAL on LongMemEval-V2: 2 writers (gpt-oss-120b, gemma-4-31B-it) x 2 readers (same two) x 2 representations (summary, structured).
_matched_set_rule: EVERY number is computed on the pair keys interpretable under ALL FOUR writer x reader combinations for that representation. A cell lost anywhere is dropped everywhere. Denominators are printed beside every number.
_raw_is_not_in_the_factorial: raw is a deterministic span with ZERO model calls, so 'writer gpt-oss raw' and 'writer Gemma raw' are the SAME BYTES. There is no writer axis for raw and it is excluded.

replicate_policy._why: prereg section 12 makes the balanced minimum-replicate subset primary; every arm is read at the first N.

_all_four_arms_are_session_matched._what: every arm was executed in the SAME session on 2026-10-01.
_all_four_arms_are_session_matched._why: a control found gpt-oss is NOT deterministic across sessions: 554 of 1124 byte-identical WITHOUT-arm requests returned different text when re-issued a day after the published run, moving the WITHOUT-arm reward by -0.0320. Using the published arms as the comparator would confound WRITER with SESSION by about the size of the effect being measured.

CROSS_SESSION_DRIFT_vs_the_published_arm._what: the SAME request re-issued in a later session. This is a measurement of endpoint stability ACROSS sessions, and it is the reason every arm above was re-run today. It is NEVER used as a comparator.

reader_gptoss._note: the WITHOUT arm has NO memory in it and its request bytes are byte-identical, so every difference here is the endpoint, not the experiment.

reader_gemma._note: the WITHOUT arm has NO memory in it and its request bytes are byte-identical, so every difference here is the endpoint, not the experiment.

arm_identity._what: the four arms must differ in exactly the two model fields. Verified on the rows themselves, not assumed from the filenames.

memory_text_checks._what: the WRITER intervention is the memory text. Within a writer the two readers must see byte-identical text; across writers it must differ. Both directions are checked -- a check that can only pass is not a check.

join_traps_demonstrated._what: run the WRONG joins and print what they return, so the rule is evidence rather than a quoted warning.
join_traps_demonstrated._note: condition_id embeds representation + writer + reader, so it can never match across arms. memory_id is a content hash over memory_text AND memory_writer_model, so it differs across writers BY CONSTRUCTION. Only locator+task is correct.

unscoreable_ledger._rule: reward/delta None means COULD NOT BE SCORED. Excluded from means and counted here. NEVER coerced to 0.0.

READER_EFFECT_REPLICATION_CHECK._what: The reader effect under writer gpt-oss is the SAME CONTRAST the published reader arm reports. It is recomputed here on the 4-way matched set AND in a fresh session, so TWO things differ from the published figure: a smaller cell set, and a different session. Both are stated; a DIRECTION or SIGNIFICANCE flip is a finding and is flagged.
READER_EFFECT_REPLICATION_CHECK._two_differences_not_one: the published number came from runs on 2026-09-30; this one was re-executed on 2026-10-01 because the WITHOUT-arm control proved gpt-oss is not deterministic across sessions. So this is NOT a pure re-computation of the published number on fewer cells -- it is a re-MEASUREMENT. See CROSS_SESSION_DRIFT_vs_the_published_arms.
READER_EFFECT_REPLICATION_CHECK._how_to_read_a_disagreement_between_the_: If the pre-committed criterion FAILS while the added one PASSES, the two estimates are statistically compatible and differ in SIGN on a near-zero quantity. That is a statement about the ESTIMAND being close to zero, not about a failure to replicate -- but the pre-committed verdict is still reported as FAILED, because a criterion rewritten after it fires is not a criterion.

summary._reading: The WITHOUT arm contains NO memory, so a WRITER change cannot move it. A non-zero change there would mean something other than the memory differed between the arms -- a defect, not a finding. F-GATE 4 asserted the WITHOUT-arm request bytes are identical across writers, so any residual here is reader sampling and should be exactly 0 at temperature 0.

memory_length_by_writer_on_matched_cells._what: the most obvious mechanism for a writer effect is simply how much the writer wrote. Reported so a writer effect is not read as a claim about compression QUALITY when it may be about compression AMOUNT.

within_memory_bearing_minus_control_per_._what: the quantity docs/REPRESENTATION_RESULT.md actually reports, computed under each of the four arms on the matched cells.

_positive_control_gem_gem_summary._what: F_exec after flipping one replicate in 144 cells. MUST be > 0, or a 0.000 floor proves nothing.

summary._rule: prereg section 4, each arm against ITS OWN measured F_exec. Using one arm's floor on another would be a different experiment.

structured._rule: prereg section 4, each arm against ITS OWN measured F_exec. Using one arm's floor on another would be a different experiment.

_positive_control_contrast_estimators._what: the four contrasts must recover KNOWN values on constructed input, or an observed zero is uninterpretable. Construction: writer effect 0.0 under reader oss, +0.5 under reader gem.
_positive_control_contrast_estimators._expected_same_family_why: +0.25 = +0.5 x the interaction of 0.5. The precommitment's '-0.5 x INTERACTION' would predict -0.25; this control is constructed from a KNOWN ground truth and so settles the sign independently of either document.
